info.description: Run with postman/run.js (fresh database, clean slate per case) or in the Postman app. See postman/README.md.

exec: // Date helpers for the tests: {{today}}, {{today_m40d}} (40 days ago), {{today_p1d}}, {{year}}, {{year_m1}}, ...
const day = (offset) => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + offset); return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`; };
for (const n of []) pm.collectionVariables.set(`year_${n > 0 ? 'p' : 'm'}${Math.abs(n)}`, year + n);

item.name: FS-001 A structure has a name, a term length and an amount per course
FS-002 [1] The term length must be a whole number of months from 1 to 12
FS-002 [2] The term length must be a whole number of months from 1 to 12
FS-002 [3] The term length must be a whole number of months from 1 to 12
FS-002 [4] The term length must be a whole number of months from 1 to 12
FS-003 Blank name, negative amount, unknown course or a repeated course are rejected

exec: pm.expect((b?.details || []).some(y => ((y !== null && typeof y === 'object' && !Array.isArray(y)) && ((typeof y?.field === 'string' && new RegExp("^amounts", "").test(y?.field))))), "details includes {\"field\": {\"$regex\": \"^amounts\"}}").to.be.true;

item.name: FS-004 Structure names are unique, ignoring case
FS-005 Structures are listed by name with usedInTimeline, and fetched by id
FS-006 A structure on the timeline can be edited unless its new term length breaks a later boundary

item.name: FS-007 Editing a structure on the timeline recalculates the dues

exec: pm.expect((b || []).every(y => ((y !== null && typeof y === 'object' && !Array.isArray(y)) && (y?.amount === 1100) && (y?.balance === 1100))), ": every item matches {\"amount\": 1100, \"balance\": 1100}").to.be.true;

item.name: FS-008 Only a structure that isn't on the timeline can be deleted
FS-009 Editing a structure on the timeline can be tried first and reports its recalculation; an unused one reports none

exec: pm.expect((b || []).every(y => ((y !== null && typeof y === 'object' && !Array.isArray(y)) && (y?.amount === 1000))), ": every item matches {\"amount\": 1000}").to.be.true;
